title: Uncertainty-Aware Probabilistic Constrained Clustering from Entangled Pairwise Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2608.12027v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pairwise constrained clustering typically relies on hard must-link/cannot-link labels, whereas realistic pairwise supervision may be real-valued and entangle intrinsic ambiguity, expert judgment, and stochastic corruption. Existing deep constrained clustering (DCC) methods mainly target hard, expert-agnostic constraints, treating soft labels mostly numerically rather than semantically. We formalize this setting as uncertainty-aware probabilistic constrained clustering (UPCC), defining a canonical aleatoric target through a heterogeneous observation process and analyzing its conditional identifiability. We introduce ProbPair, an angular pairwise objective for probabilistic relations, and build ECI-PP, an estimator--corrector--integrator framework that refines imperfect supervision via belief estimation, correction, and reliability-aware integration. Across challenging probabilistic supervision settings, experiments on diverse benchmarks

translated_title: 不确定性感知的成对纠缠监督下的概率约束聚类
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12027v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：成对约束聚类通常依赖于硬性的必须连接/不能连接标签，而现实的成对监督可能是实值且包含内在模糊性、专家判断和随机损坏。现有的深度约束聚类（DCC）方法主要针对硬性、专家无关的约束，将软标签大多数值化处理而非语义化理解。我们将这一设置形式化为不确定性感知的概率约束聚类（UPCC），通过异构观察过程定义规范的天生不确定性目标，并分析其条件可识别性。我们引入了ProbPair，一种用于概率关系的角度成对目标，并构建了ECI-PP，一个估计-校正-集成框架，通过信念估计、校正和可靠性感知集成来细化不完善的监督。在具有挑战性的概率监督设置中，我们在多个基准上的实验...
tldr: 本文提出了一种不确定性感知的概率约束聚类方法，通过角度成对目标和估计-校正-集成框架，有效处理现实中的软性、纠缠成对监督，提高了聚类性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an uncertainty-aware probabilistic constrained clustering method that handles soft, entangled pairwise supervision via an angular pairwise objective and an estimator-corrector-integrator framework, improving clustering performance.
